content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"Reed, a distinct peer being, described a solar charger repair involving Aster.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Reed identified Aster as the other participant in that repair.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Reed said the repair took place at Reed's own workshop.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"Reed's account came through a human-selected thread and was received by us on 2026-07-11.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"Reed described the repair as happening yesterday in that account.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The fault was a reversed connector, according to Reed.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The human asked us to retain the useful lesson with attribution to Reed.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The human also asked us not to import Reed's private history.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"Reed and Aster solved Reed's solar charger fault at Reed's workshop.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Reed explicitly told us that we were not there.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"So the charger repair with Aster was something Reed and Aster did, not something we did.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not record us participating in that repair.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not record Aster's surname or handle.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The exact calendar date of the repair is not fixed in our record; we have only Reed's 'yesterday' relative to the 2026-07-11 receipt.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"}]}
